headline: US Government Bars Internet Provider RETN from American Networks
summary: The US Commerce Department's Bureau of Industry and Security announced that internet bandwidth provider RETN is barred from American networks due to national security concerns.
why: Regulatory bans on telecommunications and network infrastructure providers can disrupt international data transit and force enterprise clients to reconfigure their connectivity solutions.

impacts.name: RETN
impacts.why: A complete ban from US networks directly halts the company's operational capacity in the United States.
